Selected work

Things we designed, built, and put in the field. Every part runs at the edge.

01
Vytal — Sensing

mmWave vital-signs radar.

Contactless sensing of breathing and heartbeat using millimetre-wave radar. The waveform is captured and processed entirely on the device — no wearable, no camera, nothing leaves the box.

mmWaveOn-device DSPContactless
02
Intruder Alert — Vision

A camera that understands what it sees.

A vision-language model runs directly on the unit to recognise intrusion and tampering attempts, then alerts instantly. Frames are interpreted on-device and never sent to a server.

Edge VLMInstant alertsNo cloud

Green Vytal — Production

The shipping unit.

The production revision of Vytal — a refined enclosure, lower power draw, and a tighter sensing stack. Shown here being field-tested in a live, crowded room.
